skills.name: release-bundle-preparation
skills.description: Prepare and validate a public release bundle for a sample project: semantic version, release channel, compatibility data, validation evidence, SHA-256 checksums, approval gates and rollback instructions, checked with a bundled validator script.
useCases: Package my project as a public release with checksums and rollback steps
Promote my preview release to stable and validate the release metadata
Create a release-bundle.json for v1.0.0 of my starter kit and run the validator
Check that my release bundle has a version, license, evidence and compatibility table
What do I need before I publish my sample as a stable release?
Generate SHA-256 checksums for every archive in my release
Which release channel (incubating, preview, stable, LTS) fits my project today?

skills.name: public-asset-license-review
skills.description: Review the licenses of source code, models, datasets, binaries and documents before a project is distributed publicly, mark each as redistributable, download-by-user, evaluation-only or prohibited, and flag anything that cannot be shared.
useCases: Can I publish this model checkpoint with my project?
Review the licenses of my new Python dependency before I add it
List every asset in my release bundle with its source, checksum and license
Check which files in this repo must not be redistributed
Which assets should users download themselves instead of me bundling them?
Is this dataset allowed in a public sample, or is it evaluation-only?
Write the license acknowledgement users must accept before downloading the model

skills.name: device-readiness
skills.description: Check, without changing the device, whether a publicly available Qualcomm development board is ready for a documented project workflow: reachable over SSH or USB, identified, running a supported OS image, with the required runtime and tools present.
useCases: Is my dev board ready to run this sample?
Check that my IQ-9075 EVK is reachable and running a supported OS image before I deploy
What is missing on my RB3 Gen 2 for this workflow?
Compare my board's OS image and runtime version against the project's compatibility table
Write a dated readiness record I can link from my validation evidence
Validate my hardware target before I publish the demo
Can I claim this sample works on my board, or only on my PC?
